# Crystal Cook N Serve

> Crystal Cook N Serve Products Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer of kitchenware, cookware, cutlery, cleaning aids and electric kitchen appliances, trusted by Indian homes since 1971. It sells under four brands: Crystal (World of Kitchenware), Crystalina (Splendid Finish), SparkMate (Cleaning Simplified) and ValMate (Value for Money). Products are made in India, with manufacturing at G.I.D.C Metoda, Rajkot (Gujarat) and a corporate office in Andheri (East), Mumbai.

The website is an enquiry-based product catalogue (no online checkout). Customers, retailers, bulk buyers, exporters and distributors send enquiries via the Contact page or sales@crystalcook.com.

## Key Facts

- Legal name: Crystal Cook N Serve Products Pvt. Ltd.
- Founded: 1971; started with gas stove lighters, now a complete kitchen and home solutions provider
- Brands: Crystal, Crystalina, SparkMate, ValMate
- Manufacturing: G.I.D.C Metoda, Rajkot 360021, Gujarat, India
- Corporate office: Sahar Plaza, Andheri (East), Mumbai 400059, India
- Footprint: 3 offices, 3 factories, 5 warehouses; Made in India
- Specialty: India's widest surgical stainless-steel kitchen knife range (108+ shapes and sizes)
- Recognition: HomeShop18 STAR Award (Home & Kitchen)
- B2B: bulk/institutional orders, export enquiries, distribution partnerships
- Customer support: +91-22-49702803 / 06 | sales@crystalcook.com | English, Hindi
